relevance_note: Cohort study describing several individual SSADH deficiency patients with their ALDH5A1 genotypes, e.g. 'a boy age 14 years with compound heterozygosity for ALDH5A1 variants c.1015-2A>C and c.1005C>A (p.Asn335Lys)'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script (scratch dir) assembled the JSON from hand-chosen values and spans and checked every span verbatim. Cohort study of 24 enrolled patients with no per-patient table: Table 1 gives only group counts (pediatric n=18, adolescent/adult n=6) and Table 3 lists variants without assigning them to patients, so these were not used for any individual (a 100% group count was not used to mark features observed, by analogy with the zero-count rule). Rows were made only for people the text describes individually: unnamed person 1 (participant excluded from analysis because of a neurodegenerative disorder; may overlap with persons 3 or 5, the paper does not say); unnamed person 2 (the 8-year-old girl with maximum CSS severity; first mentioned as 'One patient had daily seizures and takes 3 ASMs', identified with her because the paper says all others had 2 seizures per year or less and she has 1-2 daily seizures on 3 ASMs); unnamed person 3 (age 10, recently diagnosed epilepsy); unnamed person 4 (screened patient with c.1277G>A, excluded from enrollment because GHB was not elevated; included because the scope covers anyone with an ALDH5A1 variant, but SSADH deficiency was not confirmed and the authors call the variant nonpathogenic/benign); unnamed person 5 (14-year-old boy, SUDEP); unnamed person 6 (9-year-old boy with normal IQ); ref 24 patient (previously published boy with c.1294A>C). Not given rows: the 3 previously published SUDEP cases (refs 8,22) whose variants are listed together without a clear per-case assignment, and the 'other published cases with a severe phenotype' (refs 16,17) whose two variants are not assigned to individuals; the patient who 'fell during the study' (no clinical fact). Zygosity left not reported for unnamed person 6 (two different variants, but the paper never states compound heterozygosity for him). Transcript NM_001080.3 taken from the Methods statement covering all participants' sequencing; not applied to the screened patient or the ref 24 patient. Variant types for c.610-2A>G, c.1015-2A>C, c.1005C>A and c.612G>A come from the Table 3 rows naming those exact variants. The Markdown renders '>' as '>' and the transcript underscore as '\_' in prose; spans keep those characters verbatim while values use the printed characters. Inconsistencies noted: Abstract says 24 ALDH5A1 variants, Results says 23 different pathologic variants (Table 3 lists 24 including c.1277G>A, marked 'b' with no footnote text, although that patient was excluded from enrollment); Results says 3 patients were homozygous for missense variants while also reporting 1 participant homozygous for c.612G>A (nonsense) and 2 homozygous for c.1226G>A; the Discussion prints c.1015-2A>C as 'c.10152A>C'; protein p.Asn418llefs*39 is printed with 'll' (kept as printed, not used for any person).
